x-help:
Each food has a lifetime curve: the player's level on the x axis, the food's freshness points on the y axis. Freshness drops at the 'Ageing speed' (points per minute of play); when it reaches 0 the food becomes its 'Spoiled item'. So a curve value of 120 at your level and a speed of 1 means two hours. Foods without a row use their category's default.

Refrigerators, freezers and fermenters change how fast food ages: a rate of 0.5 halves the speed, 0 stops it, 2 doubles it. The 'Settings' page shows how long each default lasts.
